surprises.text: Two different products are named hcli: Python hcli.cli:main (slash REPL, AgentOS, install-shims) and crates/hide-backend/src/bin/hcli.rs (capabilities/run/agent/swarm). Same argv name, incompatible grammars.

surprises.text: HAWKING_CLI_SURFACE.json claims to be the sole CLI surface document (hawking.cli.surface.v1) but lists 5 commands including adapters, which is not a clap Cmd variant. Actual clap has 18 top-level verbs plus Gravity subcommands (23 leaves). bake-sidecar is a stub that writes nothing.
surprises.settle_with: Diff generated JSON against enum Cmd in crates/hawking/src/main.rs:400; regenerate from clap or stop claiming sole authority.

surprises.text: class lab.receipts.Receipt is constructed in exactly two production sites (lab/runtime.py:72 and :364). 186 non-test files import lab.receipts, almost all for seal()/verify(). On-disk hawking.lab.receipt.v1 files: 4. Unique schema field values under receipts/: 1140. Unique Python SCHEMA = constants (non-test): 1062, of which lab/operators alone has 532.
surprises.settle_with: Mutation-check: delete class Receipt and see what fails; the sealer is the real API.

surprises.text: GoalNode is well-tested (hcli/test_goal_ir.py and four sibling tests) but Mission/Engine call GoalCompiler.compile (hcli/goal.py), which emits WorkUnits. git grep of goal_compile.ingest/schedule outside tests only hits the defining module. Three goal models run in parallel.
surprises.settle_with: Add one production call from Mission to goal_compile.schedule, or document GoalIR as compiler-only IR not yet wired.

surprises.text: RuntimeProfile::Efficient's distinctive lever is HAWKING_ENERGY_EFFICIENT=1 (hawking-serve/src/lib.rs:150). git grep finds no getenv/env_on reader of that name. EnergyMode is applied via --energy-mode / Apple Fit intent, not via this env var. The profile writes an env var nothing reads.
surprises.settle_with: Add env_on("HAWKING_ENERGY_EFFICIENT") at the EnergyMode resolve site, or stop setting the var.

surprises.text: 569 unique env var names in *.py/*.rs (git grep HEAD). 220 HAWKING_*, 72 HAWKING_QWEN_*, 59 HCLI_*, 393 classified EXPERIMENTAL, 291 experimental names appear in a single file. RuntimeProfile covers ~5 Qwen levers. Do not delete diagnostic overrides; they are the bisection surface.
surprises.settle_with: Group remaining HAWKING_QWEN_* into KernelProfile JSON + keep env as override; print active levers at startup (partially exists via --explain-performance).

surprises.text: Same class names, different schemas: RuntimeGenome (hcli/providers.py vs hcli/genomes/runtime_genome.py), Obligation (ledger.py vs verifier_pipeline.py vs hide-backend ultragoal.rs), ExperimentSpec (lab/spec.py hawking.lab.experiment_spec.v1 vs lab/bench_harness/spec.py hawking.lab.experiment.v1), ResourceLimits (hcli/resources.py vs lab/engine_support.py vs hide-backend), Law (odyssey2_law_store vs autonomy_scars), Scar (autonomy_scars vs negative_index), MachineGenome (hcli/machine.py vs tools/accelerator/machine_genome.py).
